text:
sre-oncall: :rotating_light: Heads up — we missed pages to the oncall chain starting ~02:10 UTC. Alerthub is returning 429s to the paging connector and the incident channel appears to be in a suppressed state. Customer impact: degraded search for ~6 tenants reported via support. Can someone pick this up?

inc-bot: ALERT: channel suppression detected for #incidents (policy: channel_quiet). Pages suppressed. Retries paused.

liam: oncall here, I'll take it. switching to manual ringdown and enabling email fallback. initiating manual page now.

carla: looking at deploys — there was a rate-limiter tweak rolled out 02:05 UTC that touched alerthub outbound paths. seeing 429 spikes in alerthub logs.

anna: logs snippet: ```
[02:10:12 UTC] alerthub.outbound -> pager-connector 429 Too Many Requests (x-retry-after: 30)
[02:10:13 UTC] alerthub.outbound -> pager-connector 429 Too Many Requests
[02:10:14 UTC] alerthub.outbound -> pager-connector 200 OK (after retry)
```

devops: I can revert the RL patch or temporarily raise the rate-limit for the paging route. Reverting will take ~5m, but may increase noise. Thoughts?

liam: prioritize customer impact — revert the RL patch. I'll keep manual paging in place until we confirm stable.

carla: rolling back rate-limiter change now. patch id: rl-2026-03-17-07.

inc-bot: ACTION: rollback event recorded, retrying suppressed pages. Note: channel suppression still present, manual pages ongoing.

anna: after rollback we see 200s returned and no more 429s in the last 30s. monitoring.

product-support: confirmed with affected customer (acct: tenant-19) — search errors subsiding, requests are back to baseline.

liam: good. switching channel back to active for automated pages. Oncall handoff note: I'll stay on for 30m to watch for reoccurrence, then hand to next SRE. Creating ticket INC-4567 for postmortem and customer outreach.

sre-oncall: thanks team. immediate mitigation = rollback + manual ringdown. Follow-ups: 1) postmortem. 2) review channel suppression rules (why did it suppress pages for critical alerts?). 3) consider probe that verifies paging path end-to-end on deploy.

carla: adding runbook step to verify alerthub->pager health after RL changes.

liam: noting mitigation timeline in the ticket. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: closing thread for live mitigation. last checks show stable. We'll reopen if anything else pops up.
